title: SREV-025 SAMR SetSecurityObject trusted Sandboxie image gate

ms_samr_shape.description: MS-SAMR opnum 2 SamrSetSecurityObject sets access control on a SAM server, domain, user, group, or alias object; it is a security-descriptor update, not a read-only query

endpoint_filter_topology.description: Sandboxie filters SAM RPC messages at \RPC Control\samss lpc before reaching SAM; mutating SAM methods are denied; query/open methods are allowed

image_sbie_marker.description: proc->image_sbie is true only when the process image path is under the Sandboxie install directory

exception_scope.description: SamrSetSecurityObject is allowed only when proc->image_sbie is true; all other sandboxed callers fall through to the mutating-SAM deny list

deny_invariant.description: Existing mutating SAM opnums (SamSetInformationDomain, SamCreateGroupInDomain, SamCreateUserInDomain, SamCreateAliasInDomain, ...) remain denied; read/query opnums remain unaffected

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: SandboxieCrypto.exe completes SAM operation needing opnum 2; non-Sandboxie sandboxed process still denied on opnum 2; existing blocked SAM mutation opnums remain denied; read/query unaffected

contracts: SamrSetSecurityObject is denied for ordinary sandboxed clients
SamrSetSecurityObject is allowed only when proc->image_sbie is true
image_sbie is not user-settable; it is derived from image path under Sandboxie install directory
Blanket allow of opnum 2 is rejected as too broad
